# Epic 7 Context: Personal Summary Export

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

Users can request an AI-generated narrative summary plus a raw-data export for any date period from Meus Registros, and track its progress through to completion. The core guarantee is independence: the user's raw data must never be held hostage by the AI narrative step — it downloads as soon as it's ready regardless of whether the narrative is still generating, has failed, or was skipped, and a period with zero Entries is reported as a clear, non-crashing "nothing to export" state rather than an empty file or dead end. Realizes UJ-5 (a user exporting a multi-month summary before a personal check-in). Depends on Epic 4's timeline surface (export operates over the same Entry history and is launched from Meus Registros). The scope is job mechanism, file delivery, and failure handling only — the quality of the generated narrative text is explicitly outside acceptance scope.

## Stories

- Story 7.1: Request a Period Export & Job Status Tracking
- Story 7.2: Narrative-Independent Raw-Data Download
- Story 7.3: Empty-Period Handling

## Requirements & Constraints

- Requesting an export is synchronous-on-enqueue: the create call returns a `jobId` and an initial `pending` status immediately; all progress after that is observed by polling a status endpoint (no push/streaming for export).
- The job's own `status` and the AI narrative's `narrativeStatus` are reported independently by the status endpoint, together with an entry count, per-leg error codes, and an explicit "download available" flag — the UI must branch on both fields together, never infer one from the other.
- Five user-visible states cover every combination: preparing (no download), generating summary (no download), a hybrid "data ready, summary still generating" state (raw download already enabled while narrative keeps processing underneath — this combination is not one of the five states shown in the prototype itself but is required by the live contract), done-with-summary (both PDF and raw download), and done-or-error-with-narrative-only-failure (raw download only, error copy framed around the narrative, never around the whole job).
- An export requested over a period with zero Entries surfaces as its own terminal state ("Período vazio") — no download offered, no crash — and the copy should suggest adjusting the period/filter rather than leaving a dead end.
- The narrative step uses a hosted AI model server-side; the app never calls it directly and never grades or asserts on the generated text's content.
- Downloading a finished artifact (PDF or raw) resolves through a redirect to a signed storage URL, not a direct JSON payload.
- Every export error still carries the shared `{ code, message, retryable }` shape; `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` is non-retryable, so it is never fed into generic retry handling.

## Technical Decisions

- Export lives in its own feature slice, following the same layer direction and `Either<Failure, T>` repository boundary used everywhere else; it introduces no new error-signaling shape.
- The closed, shared `Failure` hierarchy already carries a dedicated case for the empty-period error; export must map onto that existing case rather than defining a feature-local error type.
- The job's progress (pending → processing → data-ready/done/error, with narrative status layered on top) is its own small sealed state class, not forced into the shared single-fetch `idle/loading/data/error` resource pattern — this mirrors how other multi-stage async flows (capture processing, chat streaming) in this codebase already get their own state machine rather than reusing the generic one.
- Retry behavior for the underlying HTTP calls is not reimplemented per feature — the shared API client already retries the handful of server codes marked retryable, and export's status/download calls follow that same single retry path rather than adding a second one.
- Calls are made by function name, never the literal REST path: export's three operations (create job, poll status, download) each resolve to their own named endpoint, with the job id appended as a trailing path segment where required.
- Prefer one export surface with an internal status enum over separate routes per stage — the underlying job has five+ states but is one continuously-updating surface, not five screens.

## UX & Interaction Patterns

- Entry point is a download icon in the Meus Registros header; it opens a bottom sheet — the heaviest sheet surface in the product short of a full-screen modal — using the same rise-from-bottom entrance timing as other sheets (skipped under Reduce Motion, final state shown immediately instead).
- Each stage transition replaces the sheet's content in place; the sheet itself never closes and reopens mid-job, and every state keeps a "Fechar" dismiss affordance.
- State copy is plain and factual, never celebratory: preparing shows a spinner ("Preparando exportação..."); generating shows a progress bar ("Gerando resumo com IA..."); the hybrid state shows the raw-data download already enabled with summary-progress text still visible underneath; full success shows a confirmation plus both download actions (PDF primary, raw data secondary); a narrative-only failure keeps just the raw-data action with error copy scoped to the narrative; the empty-period state shows explanatory copy and a suggestion to adjust the period, with no download action at all.
- No swipe gestures and no nested overlays — the export sheet sits alone on the scrim over Meus Registros, never stacking on another sheet.

## Cross-Story Dependencies

- Story 7.1 establishes the export request + status-polling state machine; Stories 7.2 and 7.3 are both refinements of states that machine must already be able to represent (the data-ready hybrid state, and the empty-period terminal state), not independent flows.
- The epic depends on Meus Registros (Epic 4) already existing as the launch surface and as the source of the period/filter the export is requested over.

  **Date-period picker precedent**: `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet.dart` has `DateRangePreset` (3 fixed presets: `allTime`/`thisWeek`/`thisMonth`, `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/date_range_preset.dart:15-38`, each with `rangeFrom(DateTime now) -> (DateTime?, DateTime?)`) — this is a **preset chooser**, not an arbitrary start/end date picker.   ## 6. Bottom sheet precedent (`EntriesFilterSheet.show`)
  
  `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet.dart:70-114` is the clearest, most recent precedent (explicitly says it "mirrors `InsertionModal.show()`'s own bottom-sheet choreography"):
  
  ```dart
  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, {...}) async {
    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
    final controller = BottomSheet.createAnimationController(Navigator.of(context))
      ..duration = reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : DesignTokens.durationSheetUp
      ..reverseDuration = reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : null;
    try {
      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
        context: context,
        isScrollControlled: true,
        useSafeArea: true,
        barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        transitionAnimationController: controller,
        builder: (_) => EntriesFilterSheet(...),
      );
    } finally {
      // waits for reverse animation to finish (AnimationStatus.dismissed) before controller.dispose()
    }
  }
  ```

  ---
  
  ## 7. Backend contract (`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml` + `export-screen-states.md`)
  
  ### `POST /export/summary` (`openapi.yaml:1417-1476`)
  - `operationId: export.summary.create`, **`x-cerne-function: export-summary-create`**, `security: [bearerAuth]`.
  - Request body (required): `{ periodStart: string(date-time, nullable), periodEnd: string(date-time, nullable), includeNarrative: boolean(default true) }`; `required: [periodStart, periodEnd]` (note: fields are `nullable: true` in schema but also listed as `required` — i.e. the keys must be present, value may be `null`).
  - Response `202`: `{ data: { jobId: string(uuid), status: "pending" (enum, single value) }, meta: object }`; `required: [jobId, status]` under `data`.
  - Error: default `$ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'`.

    - `status` enum: **`pending | processing | data_ready | done | error`** (5 values) — note: NOT the same as the AC's 5 named screen states; `data_ready` is a hybrid state (UX-DR34), and "Período vazio" is actually `status=error` + `errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD`, not a distinct `status` enum value.
    - `narrativeStatus` enum: **`pending | processing | done | failed | skipped`** (5 values)
    - `entryCount`: integer, min 0, `nullable: true`
    - `errorCode`: string, `nullable: true`
    - `narrativeErrorCode`: string, `nullable: true`
    - `downloadAvailable`: boolean (not nullable)

  - `operationId: export.download.get`, **`x-cerne-function: export-download-get`**, path param `jobId`, query param `format: pdf|raw` (default `pdf`).
  - `302` redirect to signed Storage URL (no JSON body on success) — out of scope for 7.1, needed for 7.2.
  
  ### `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md` (full file, 15 lines) — the authoritative state table:
  
  | Screen state | `status` | `narrativeStatus` | Download available |
  |---|---|---|---|

5	/// AD-3 — the one closed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes: the 13
6	/// codes from `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` plus the local-only
7	/// `malformedResponse` (client-side parse failure, never sent by the
8	/// backend). Never redefined or subset per feature; every repository method
9	/// returns `Either<Failure, T>` built from this type (RNF09).
10	///
11	/// `retryable` is derived here, once, from the 6 server `retryable:true`
12	/// codes (AD-4) — no other file re-decides which codes retry.
13	@freezed
14	sealed class Failure with _$Failure {
15	  const factory Failure.authExpired({required String message}) = AuthExpired;
16	  const factory Failure.authInvalid({required String message}) = AuthInvalid;
17	  const factory Failure.networkTimeout({required String message}) =
18	      NetworkTimeout;
19	  const factory Failure.networkOffline({required String message}) =
20	      NetworkOffline;
21	  const factory Failure.validation({required String message}) = Validation;
22	  const factory Failure.piiCheckFailed({required String message}) =
23	      PiiCheckFailed;
24	  const factory Failure.embeddingFailed({required String message}) =
25	      EmbeddingFailed;
26	  const factory Failure.aiGenerationTimeout({required String message}) =
27	      AiGenerationTimeout;
28	  const factory Failure.notFound({required String message}) = NotFound;
29	  const factory Failure.rateLimited({required String message}) = RateLimited;
30	  const factory Failure.exportEmptyPeriod({required String message}) =
31	      ExportEmptyPeriod;
32	  const factory Failure.payloadTooLarge({required String message}) =
33	      PayloadTooLarge;
34	  const factory Failure.ocrNoText({required String message}) = OcrNoText;
35	
36	  /// Local-only — the client's own parse-failure detection. `retryable` is
37	  /// hardcoded `false` for this subtype (AD-3).
38	  const factory Failure.malformedResponse({required String message}) =
39	      MalformedResponse;
40	
41	  const Failure._();
42	
43	  /// The 6 server `retryable:true` codes (AD-4). Every other code —
44	  /// including the local `malformedResponse` — is `false`.
45	  bool get retryable => switch (this) {
46	        NetworkTimeout() => true,
47	        NetworkOffline() => true,
48	        PiiCheckFailed() => true,
49	        EmbeddingFailed() => true,
50	        AiGenerationTimeout() => true,
51	        RateLimited() => true,
52	        AuthExpired() ||
53	        AuthInvalid() ||
54	        Validation() ||
55	        NotFound() ||
56	        ExportEmptyPeriod() ||
57	        PayloadTooLarge() ||
58	        OcrNoText() ||
59	        MalformedResponse() =>
60	          false,
61	      };
62	
63	  /// Maps a backend error `code` (`error-taxonomy.md`) to its `Failure`
64	  /// subtype. An unrecognized code (should never happen — the taxonomy is
65	  /// closed) falls back to [Failure.malformedResponse] rather than throwing,
66	  /// so no repository ever lets an unmapped error escape (RNF09).
67	  factory Failure.fromCode(String code, String message) => switch (code) {
68	        'AUTH_EXPIRED' => Failure.authExpired(message: message),
69	        'AUTH_INVALID' => Failure.authInvalid(message: message),
70	        'NETWORK_TIMEOUT' => Failure.networkTimeout(message: message),
71	        'NETWORK_OFFLINE' => Failure.networkOffline(message: message),
72	        'VALIDATION_ERROR' => Failure.validation(message: message),
73	        'PII_CHECK_FAILED' => Failure.piiCheckFailed(message: message),
74	        'EMBEDDING_FAILED' => Failure.embeddingFailed(message: message),
75	        'AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT' =>
76	          Failure.aiGenerationTimeout(message: message),
77	        'NOT_FOUND' => Failure.notFound(message: message),
78	        'RATE_LIMITED' => Failure.rateLimited(message: message),
79	        'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD' => Failure.exportEmptyPeriod(message: message),
80	        'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE' => Failure.payloadTooLarge(message: message),
81	        'OCR_NO_TEXT' => Failure.ocrNoText(message: message),
82	        _ => Failure.malformedResponse(message: message),
83	      };
84	}

# Export screen states (RF05)

`export_jobs` has two **independent** statuses — the status of the job itself (`status`) and the status of the AI-generated narrative (`narrativeStatus`) — because the raw export data can be ready before, after or independently of the narrative, and the UI must never block the download because of a narrative that failed. Both come from `GET /export/{jobId}/status`, together with `downloadAvailable`.

| What the screen shows | `status` | `narrativeStatus` | Download available |
|---|---|---|---|
| Preparing export | `pending` | `pending` | no |
| Generating AI summary | `processing` | `processing` | no |
| Data ready, summary still generating | `data_ready` | `processing` | yes (no PDF) |
| Done, with summary | `done` | `done` | yes (with PDF) |
| Done, summary failed or skipped | `done` | `failed` or `skipped` | yes (no PDF) |
| Export error | `error` | — | no |

This mapping covers only the export screen. The states of the other screens are in `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` and in `docs/input/requirements.md`.

---
title: 'Request a Period Export & Job Status Tracking'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-06'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to request an export; the backend already exposes job creation (`POST /export/summary`) and polling (`GET /export/:jobId/status`), but `lib/features/export/` is three empty scaffold folders — nothing is built.

**Approach:** Build the `export` feature slice (data/domain/presentation) end to end: a download icon on Meus Registros opens a period picker, confirming creates the job, and a bottom sheet polls status and swaps its content in place across the five named states (Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio), reusing the existing sheet, button, and `Failure` infrastructure rather than inventing new ones.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `export-summary-create` and `export-status-get` by their `x-cerne-function` name with `jobId` as a trailing path segment — never the literal `/export/summary` or `/export/{jobId}/status` paths.
- Poll; never stream/push. Reuse the existing closed `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` case for "Período vazio" — never add a new `Failure` subtype (AD-3).
- Model job progress as its own sealed domain entity (mirror `BookmarkState`'s `const factory`-on-base shape) — never squeeze the two independent `status`/`narrativeStatus` axes into `Resource<T>` (AD-12).
- Sheet content replaces in place on every stage change; the sheet itself never closes/reopens mid-job; every state keeps a "Fechar" dismiss link (epics.md UX-DR15).
- Add `export-summary-create` to `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions` — it is a non-idempotent POST with no idempotency key; a transparent retry would risk creating a second job.

**Ask First:** None identified — docs/input is silent on poll cadence and the period-picker widget; both are decided below (Design Notes) per AGENTS.md policy rather than left open.

**Never:**
- Never wire the actual download (`GET /export/:jobId/download`) or make "Baixar PDF"/"Baixar dados brutos" functional — Story 7.2.
- Never give the `data_ready` hybrid state its own distinct visual/download-enabled treatment — Story 7.2; render it identically to "Processando" here.
- Never add empty-period-specific UX polish beyond the table in `export-screen-states.md` — Story 7.3.
- Never persist export jobs locally (no Hive box) — ephemeral, polled live (AD-15).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Create job | Confirm period | `jobId` stored, sheet opens in Pendente | Create fails (e.g. validation) → inline error before sheet opens, sheet never opens |
| Pendente | `status=pending` | Spinner, "Preparando exportação..." | N/A |
| Processando | `status=processing` or `data_ready` | Progress bar, "Gerando resumo com IA..." | N/A |
| Concluído | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus=done` | "Resumo pronto", PDF (primary) + raw (outline) buttons shown, disabled (7.2 wires taps) | N/A |
| Narrativa falhou/pulada | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus in {failed,skipped}` | Only raw button shown; copy scoped to the narrative only | N/A |
| Erro | `status=error`, `errorCode != EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | Generic error copy, no download | Non-retryable → terminal, "Fechar" still works |
| Período vazio | `status=error`, `errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | "Nenhum registro nesse período." + suggestion to adjust period | Maps to existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/export/{data,domain,presentation}/` -- empty scaffold; target location for every file below
- `lib/core/network/api_client.dart:43-65` -- `ApiClient.get/post(function, {pathParams, data})` signature to call through
- `lib/core/network/url_builder.dart:16-20` -- confirms `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>/<pathParam>` URL building
- `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart:36-40` -- `neverRetriedFunctions` set; add `'export-summary-create'`
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:30-31,67-83` -- `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod`/`fromCode('EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD', ...)` already defined and wired; reuse, don't add
- `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_state.dart:1-21` -- sealed-base + `const factory` pattern to mirror for the new state entity
- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart:44-46` -- `registerFactory<TextEntryCubit>` precedent for a one-shot-per-open cubit
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:93-97` -- feature registration order; add `registerExportFeature()` after `registerChatFeature()`
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet.dart:70-114,160-169` -- `showModalBottomSheet` choreography (Reduce-Motion-aware controller, `radiusLg`/`elevation2`/`colorScrimHeavy`/`durationSheetUp`) to mirror
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:202` -- `BackArrowHeader` call site; needs a trailing download-icon action
- `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart:1-39` -- no trailing-action slot today; add one (optional, default null, so the other two screens using it are unaffected)
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- `AppButtonVariant.primary/secondaryOutline/textGhost` for PDF/raw/"Fechar"
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1417-1550` -- `export.summary.create`/`export.status.get` request/response schemas, enums
- `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md` -- authoritative `status`×`narrativeStatus`×`downloadAvailable` table
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:95-104` -- exact PT-BR copy per state, "Fechar" link on all five

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add any new export-specific tokens (status icon size, etc.) following the existing per-feature naming convention -- AGENTS.md forbids visual values elsewhere
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` -- add optional `trailing` widget param -- lets Meus Registros add a download icon with no change to the other two consuming screens
- [ ] `lib/features/export/domain/entities/export_job_state.dart` -- new sealed class: `preparing`, `generating`, `dataReady(entryCount)`, `done(narrativeOutcome)`, `error(Failure)`, `emptyPeriod()` -- the two independent status axes collapsed into one small state machine (AD-12)
- [ ] `lib/features/export/domain/repositories/export_repository.dart` -- abstract `createJob({periodStart, periodEnd}) -> Either<Failure, String>` (jobId), `getStatus(jobId) -> Either<Failure, ExportJobState>`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/models/export_job_status_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- `json_serializable` DTO mirroring the status-endpoint response fields
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart` -- calls `export-summary-create`/`export-status-get`; maps the DTO to `ExportJobState` per `export-screen-states.md`'s table (`errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` → `.emptyPeriod()`)
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/repositories/export_repository_impl.dart` -- thin pass-through, no cache
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<ExportJobState>`; `start({periodStart, periodEnd})` creates the job then `Timer.periodic` polls status every 2s until a terminal state; cancels the timer in `close()`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart` -- static `.show(context, {required cubit})` mirroring `EntriesFilterSheet.show`'s choreography; `BlocBuilder` body swaps content per state; "Fechar" on every state
- [ ] `lib/features/export/export_injection.dart` -- `registerExportFeature()`: lazy singleton data source + repository, `registerFactory<ExportJobCubit>`
- [ ] `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- call `registerExportFeature()` after `registerChatFeature()`
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- download icon in the header's new trailing slot; `onTap` opens `showDateRangePicker`, then `sl<ExportJobCubit>().start(...)` followed by `ExportStatusSheet.show(...)`
- [ ] `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart` -- add `'export-summary-create'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`
- [ ] Unit tests for `ExportJobCubit` (state transitions across the I/O matrix rows) and `ExportRemoteDataSource` (DTO→state mapping, incl. `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I tap the download icon on Meus Registros and select a period, when I confirm, then `POST /export/summary` creates the job and the export sheet opens (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`).
- Given the job is in progress, when I poll `GET /export/:jobId/status`, then the sheet reflects the five named states, reporting `status` and `narrativeStatus` independently.
- Given a stage changes, when the sheet updates, then it replaces its content in place — never closes and reopens mid-job.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- Poll interval: docs/input is silent; decided as a fixed 2s `Timer.periodic`, no hard client-side timeout (server-side job eventually reaches a terminal state).
- Period picker: docs/input is silent on the exact widget; decided to use Flutter's built-in `showDateRangePicker` rather than a custom sheet, since the free-form `periodStart`/`periodEnd` fields aren't tied to the 3 fixed presets `DateRangePreset` already defines for filtering.
- `data_ready` folds into the `generating`/"Processando" visual for this story — same copy, same no-download treatment — since enabling the raw-data button is explicitly Story 7.2's job:

```dart
sealed class ExportJobState {
  const ExportJobState();
  const factory ExportJobState.preparing() = _Preparing;
  const factory ExportJobState.generating() = _Generating; // + dataReady
  const factory ExportJobState.done(NarrativeOutcome outcome) = _Done;
  const factory ExportJobState.error(Failure failure) = _Error;
  const factory ExportJobState.emptyPeriod() = _EmptyPeriod;
}
```

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- expected: generates `export_job_status_dto.g.dart` with no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new `ExportJobCubit`/`ExportRemoteDataSource` tests

title: 'Request a Period Export & Job Status Tracking'
type: 'feature'

status: 'draft'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to request an export; the backend already exposes job creation (`POST /export/summary`) and polling (`GET /export/:jobId/status`), but `lib/features/export/` is three empty scaffold folders — nothing is built.

**Approach:** Build the `export` feature slice (data/domain/presentation) end to end: a download icon on Meus Registros opens a period picker, confirming creates the job, and a bottom sheet polls status and swaps its content in place across the five named states (Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio), reusing the existing sheet, button, and `Failure` infrastructure rather than inventing new ones.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `export-summary-create` and `export-status-get` by their `x-cerne-function` name with `jobId` as a trailing path segment — never the literal `/export/summary` or `/export/{jobId}/status` paths.
- Poll; never stream/push. Reuse the existing closed `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` case for "Período vazio" — never add a new `Failure` subtype (AD-3).
- Model job progress as its own sealed domain entity (mirror `BookmarkState`'s `const factory`-on-base shape) — never squeeze the two independent `status`/`narrativeStatus` axes into `Resource<T>` (AD-12).
- Sheet content replaces in place on every stage change; the sheet itself never closes/reopens mid-job; every state keeps a "Fechar" dismiss link (epics.md UX-DR15).
- Add `export-summary-create` to `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions` — it is a non-idempotent POST with no idempotency key; a transparent retry would risk creating a second job.

**Ask First:** None identified — docs/input is silent on poll cadence and the period-picker widget; both are decided below (Design Notes) per AGENTS.md policy rather than left open.

**Never:**
- Never wire the actual download (`GET /export/:jobId/download`) or make "Baixar PDF"/"Baixar dados brutos" functional — Story 7.2.
- Never give the `data_ready` hybrid state its own distinct visual/download-enabled treatment — Story 7.2; render it identically to "Processando" here.
- Never add empty-period-specific UX polish beyond the table in `export-screen-states.md` — Story 7.3.
- Never persist export jobs locally (no Hive box) — ephemeral, polled live (AD-15).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Create job | Confirm period | `jobId` stored, sheet opens in Pendente | Create fails (e.g. validation) → inline error before sheet opens, sheet never opens |
| Pendente | `status=pending` | Spinner, "Preparando exportação..." | N/A |
| Processando | `status=processing` or `data_ready` | Progress bar, "Gerando resumo com IA..." | N/A |
| Concluído | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus=done` | "Resumo pronto", PDF (primary) + raw (outline) buttons shown, disabled (7.2 wires taps) | N/A |
| Narrativa falhou/pulada | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus in {failed,skipped}` | Only raw button shown; copy scoped to the narrative only | N/A |
| Erro | `status=error`, `errorCode != EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | Generic error copy, no download | Non-retryable → terminal, "Fechar" still works |
| Período vazio | `status=error`, `errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | "Nenhum registro nesse período." + suggestion to adjust period | Maps to existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/export/{data,domain,presentation}/` -- empty scaffold; target location for every file below
- `lib/core/network/api_client.dart:43-65` -- `ApiClient.get/post(function, {pathParams, data})` signature to call through
- `lib/core/network/url_builder.dart:16-20` -- confirms `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>/<pathParam>` URL building
- `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart:36-40` -- `neverRetriedFunctions` set; add `'export-summary-create'`
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:30-31,67-83` -- `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod`/`fromCode('EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD', ...)` already defined and wired; reuse, don't add
- `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_state.dart:1-21` -- sealed-base + `const factory` pattern to mirror for the new state entity
- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart:44-46` -- `registerFactory<TextEntryCubit>` precedent for a one-shot-per-open cubit
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:93-97` -- feature registration order; add `registerExportFeature()` after `registerChatFeature()`
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet.dart:70-114,160-169` -- `showModalBottomSheet` choreography (Reduce-Motion-aware controller, `radiusLg`/`elevation2`/`colorScrimHeavy`/`durationSheetUp`) to mirror
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:202` -- `BackArrowHeader` call site; needs a trailing download-icon action
- `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart:1-39` -- no trailing-action slot today; add one (optional, default null, so the other two screens using it are unaffected)
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- `AppButtonVariant.primary/secondaryOutline/textGhost` for PDF/raw/"Fechar"
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1417-1550` -- `export.summary.create`/`export.status.get` request/response schemas, enums
- `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md` -- authoritative `status`×`narrativeStatus`×`downloadAvailable` table
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:95-104` -- exact PT-BR copy per state, "Fechar" link on all five

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add any new export-specific tokens (status icon size, etc.) following the existing per-feature naming convention -- AGENTS.md forbids visual values elsewhere
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` -- add optional `trailing` widget param -- lets Meus Registros add a download icon with no change to the other two consuming screens
- [ ] `lib/features/export/domain/entities/export_job_state.dart` -- new sealed class: `preparing`, `generating`, `dataReady(entryCount)`, `done(narrativeOutcome)`, `error(Failure)`, `emptyPeriod()` -- the two independent status axes collapsed into one small state machine (AD-12)
- [ ] `lib/features/export/domain/repositories/export_repository.dart` -- abstract `createJob({periodStart, periodEnd}) -> Either<Failure, String>` (jobId), `getStatus(jobId) -> Either<Failure, ExportJobState>`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/models/export_job_status_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- `json_serializable` DTO mirroring the status-endpoint response fields
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart` -- calls `export-summary-create`/`export-status-get`; maps the DTO to `ExportJobState` per `export-screen-states.md`'s table (`errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` → `.emptyPeriod()`)
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/repositories/export_repository_impl.dart` -- thin pass-through, no cache
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<ExportJobState>`; `start({periodStart, periodEnd})` creates the job then `Timer.periodic` polls status every 2s until a terminal state; cancels the timer in `close()`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart` -- static `.show(context, {required cubit})` mirroring `EntriesFilterSheet.show`'s choreography; `BlocBuilder` body swaps content per state; "Fechar" on every state
- [ ] `lib/features/export/export_injection.dart` -- `registerExportFeature()`: lazy singleton data source + repository, `registerFactory<ExportJobCubit>`
- [ ] `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- call `registerExportFeature()` after `registerChatFeature()`
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- download icon in the header's new trailing slot; `onTap` opens `showDateRangePicker`, then `sl<ExportJobCubit>().start(...)` followed by `ExportStatusSheet.show(...)`
- [ ] `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart` -- add `'export-summary-create'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`
- [ ] Unit tests for `ExportJobCubit` (state transitions across the I/O matrix rows) and `ExportRemoteDataSource` (DTO→state mapping, incl. `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I tap the download icon on Meus Registros and select a period, when I confirm, then `POST /export/summary` creates the job and the export sheet opens (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`).
- Given the job is in progress, when I poll `GET /export/:jobId/status`, then the sheet reflects the five named states, reporting `status` and `narrativeStatus` independently.
- Given a stage changes, when the sheet updates, then it replaces its content in place — never closes and reopens mid-job.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- Poll interval: docs/input is silent; decided as a fixed 2s `Timer.periodic`, no hard client-side timeout (server-side job eventually reaches a terminal state).
- Period picker: docs/input is silent on the exact widget; decided to use Flutter's built-in `showDateRangePicker` rather than a custom sheet, since the free-form `periodStart`/`periodEnd` fields aren't tied to the 3 fixed presets `DateRangePreset` already defines for filtering.
- `data_ready` folds into the `generating`/"Processando" visual for this story — same copy, same no-download treatment — since enabling the raw-data button is explicitly Story 7.2's job:

```dart

  const ExportJobState();
  const factory ExportJobState.preparing() = _Preparing;
  const factory ExportJobState.generating() = _Generating; // + dataReady
  const factory ExportJobState.done(NarrativeOutcome outcome) = _Done;
  const factory ExportJobState.error(Failure failure) = _Error;
  const factory ExportJobState.emptyPeriod() = _EmptyPeriod;
}
```

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- expected: generates `export_job_status_dto.g.dart` with no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including new `ExportJobCubit`/`ExportRemoteDataSource` tests

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no export entry point; the backend already exposes job creation (`POST /export/summary`) and polling (`GET /export/:jobId/status`), but `lib/features/export/` is three empty scaffold folders.

**Approach:** Build the `export` feature slice end to end: a download icon opens a period picker, confirming creates the job, and a bottom sheet polls status, swapping content in place across Pendente/Processando/Concluído/Erro/Período vazio, reusing existing sheet, button, and `Failure` infrastructure.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `export-summary-create`/`export-status-get` by `x-cerne-function` name, `jobId` as trailing path segment — never the literal REST paths.
- Poll only, never stream. Reuse the existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` for "Período vazio" — never add a new `Failure` subtype (AD-3).

- Sheet content replaces in place per stage change; sheet never closes/reopens mid-job; every state keeps "Fechar" (UX-DR15).
- Add `export-summary-create` to `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions` (non-idempotent POST, no idempotency key — a transparent retry risks a duplicate job).

**Ask First:** None — docs/input is silent on poll cadence and the period-picker widget; both decided in Design Notes per AGENTS.md policy.

**Never:**
- Wire the real download (`GET /export/:jobId/download`) or make "Baixar PDF"/"Baixar dados brutos" tap-functional — Story 7.2.
- Give `data_ready` its own visual/download-enabled treatment — Story 7.2; render identically to "Processando" here.
- Add empty-period UX polish beyond `export-screen-states.md`'s table — Story 7.3.
- Persist jobs locally (no Hive box) — ephemeral, polled live (AD-15).

title: 'Request a Period Export & Job Status Tracking'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-06'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no export entry point; the backend already exposes job creation (`POST /export/summary`) and polling (`GET /export/:jobId/status`), but `lib/features/export/` is three empty scaffold folders.

**Approach:** Build the `export` feature slice end to end: a download icon opens a period picker, confirming creates the job, and a bottom sheet polls status, swapping content in place across Pendente/Processando/Concluído/Erro/Período vazio, reusing existing sheet, button, and `Failure` infrastructure.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `export-summary-create`/`export-status-get` by `x-cerne-function` name, `jobId` as trailing path segment — never the literal REST paths.
- Poll only, never stream. Reuse the existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` for "Período vazio" — never add a new `Failure` subtype (AD-3).
- Model progress as its own sealed domain entity (mirror `BookmarkState`) — never force `status`+`narrativeStatus` into `Resource<T>` (AD-12).
- Sheet content replaces in place per stage change; sheet never closes/reopens mid-job; every state keeps "Fechar" (UX-DR15).
- Add `export-summary-create` to `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions` (non-idempotent POST, no idempotency key — a transparent retry risks a duplicate job).

**Ask First:** None — docs/input is silent on poll cadence and the period-picker widget; both decided in Design Notes per AGENTS.md policy.

**Never:**
- Wire the real download (`GET /export/:jobId/download`) or make "Baixar PDF"/"Baixar dados brutos" tap-functional — Story 7.2.
- Give `data_ready` its own visual/download-enabled treatment — Story 7.2; render identically to "Processando" here.
- Add empty-period UX polish beyond `export-screen-states.md`'s table — Story 7.3.
- Persist jobs locally (no Hive box) — ephemeral, polled live (AD-15).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|------------------|-----------------|
| Create job | Confirm period | `jobId` stored, sheet opens Pendente | Create fails → inline error, sheet never opens |
| Pendente | `status=pending` | Spinner, "Preparando exportação..." | N/A |
| Processando | `status=processing\|data_ready` | Progress bar, "Gerando resumo com IA..." | N/A |
| Concluído | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus=done` | "Resumo pronto", PDF+raw buttons shown (disabled; 7.2 wires taps) | N/A |
| Narrativa falhou/pulada | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus in {failed,skipped}` | Only raw button; copy scoped to narrative | N/A |
| Erro | `status=error`, other `errorCode` | Generic error copy, no download | Non-retryable, terminal |
| Período vazio | `errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | "Nenhum registro nesse período." + adjust-period suggestion | Maps to `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/export/{data,domain,presentation}/` -- empty scaffold; target for all files below
- `lib/core/network/api_client.dart:43-65` -- `get/post(function, {pathParams, data})` to call through
- `lib/core/network/url_builder.dart:16-20` -- `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>/<pathParam>` building
- `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart:36-40` -- `neverRetriedFunctions`; add `'export-summary-create'`
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:30-31,67-83` -- `exportEmptyPeriod` already defined/wired; reuse only
- `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_state.dart:1-21` -- sealed-base `const factory` pattern to mirror
- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart:44-46` -- `registerFactory<TextEntryCubit>` one-shot-cubit precedent
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:93-97` -- registration order; add `registerExportFeature()` after chat
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet.dart:70-114,160-169` -- sheet choreography + shell (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`/`colorScrimHeavy`/`durationSheetUp`) to mirror
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:202` -- `BackArrowHeader` call site needing a trailing action
- `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart:1-39` -- no trailing slot today; add one (optional, default null)
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- `primary`/`secondaryOutline`/`textGhost` for PDF/raw/"Fechar"
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1417-1550` -- `export.summary.create`/`export.status.get` schemas
- `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md` -- authoritative status×narrativeStatus×downloadAvailable table
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:95-104` -- exact PT-BR copy per state

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- add export-specific tokens as needed (icon sizes etc.), existing naming convention
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` -- optional `trailing` param
- [ ] `lib/features/export/domain/entities/export_job_state.dart` -- sealed: `preparing`/`generating`/`done(outcome)`/`error(Failure)`/`emptyPeriod`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/domain/repositories/export_repository.dart` -- `createJob({periodStart, periodEnd}) -> Either<Failure, String>`; `getStatus(jobId) -> Either<Failure, ExportJobState>`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/models/export_job_status_dto.dart` (+`.g.dart`) -- `json_serializable` DTO of the status response
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart` -- calls the two functions; maps DTO → `ExportJobState` per the status table
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/repositories/export_repository_impl.dart` -- thin pass-through, no cache
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<ExportJobState>`; `start()` creates job then `Timer.periodic` (2s) polls to a terminal state; cancels in `close()`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart` -- static `.show(context, {cubit})` mirroring filter-sheet choreography; `BlocBuilder` swaps body per state
- [ ] `lib/features/export/export_injection.dart` -- `registerExportFeature()`: singleton data source + repository, `registerFactory<ExportJobCubit>`
- [ ] `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- call `registerExportFeature()`
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- download icon in header trailing slot; `onTap` → `showDateRangePicker` → `start()` → `ExportStatusSheet.show()`
- [ ] `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart` -- add `'export-summary-create'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`
- [ ] Unit tests: `ExportJobCubit` transitions (I/O matrix rows), `ExportRemoteDataSource` DTO→state mapping incl. empty period

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I tap the download icon and select a period, when I confirm, then the job is created and the export sheet opens (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`).
- Given the job is in progress, when polled, then the sheet reflects the five named states, `status`/`narrativeStatus` independent.
- Given a stage changes, when the sheet updates, then content replaces in place — never closes/reopens mid-job.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- Poll: fixed 2s `Timer.periodic`, no client timeout (docs/input silent; server job always reaches a terminal state).
- Period picker: Flutter's built-in `showDateRangePicker` (docs/input silent; free-form dates, unlike the 3 fixed `DateRangePreset` filter presets).
- `data_ready` folds into `generating`'s visual here (no case of its own) — same copy/no-download, since lighting it up is 7.2's job.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates the DTO's `.g.dart`, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- all pass, incl. new cubit/data-source tests

title: 'Request a Period Export & Job Status Tracking'
type: 'feature'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no export entry point; the backend already exposes job creation (`POST /export/summary`) and polling (`GET /export/:jobId/status`), but `lib/features/export/` is three empty scaffold folders.

**Approach:** Build the `export` feature slice end to end: a download icon opens a period picker, confirming creates the job, and a bottom sheet polls status, swapping content in place across Pendente/Processando/Concluído/Erro/Período vazio, reusing existing sheet, button, and `Failure` infrastructure.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `export-summary-create`/`export-status-get` by `x-cerne-function` name, `jobId` as trailing path segment — never the literal REST paths.
- Poll only, never stream. Reuse the existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` for "Período vazio" — never add a new `Failure` subtype (AD-3).
- Model progress as its own sealed domain entity (mirror `BookmarkState`) — never force `status`+`narrativeStatus` into `Resource<T>` (AD-12).
- Sheet content replaces in place per stage change; sheet never closes/reopens mid-job; every state keeps "Fechar" (UX-DR15).
- Add `export-summary-create` to `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions` (non-idempotent POST, no idempotency key — a transparent retry risks a duplicate job).

**Ask First:** None — docs/input is silent on poll cadence and the period-picker widget; both decided in Design Notes per AGENTS.md policy.

**Never:**
- Wire the real download (`GET /export/:jobId/download`) or make "Baixar PDF"/"Baixar dados brutos" tap-functional — Story 7.2.
- Give `data_ready` its own visual/download-enabled treatment — Story 7.2; render identically to "Processando" here.
- Add empty-period UX polish beyond `export-screen-states.md`'s table — Story 7.3.
- Persist jobs locally (no Hive box) — ephemeral, polled live (AD-15).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|------------------|-----------------|
| Create job | Confirm period | `jobId` stored, sheet opens Pendente | Create fails → inline error, sheet never opens |
| Pendente | `status=pending` | Spinner, "Preparando exportação..." | N/A |
| Processando | `status=processing\|data_ready` | Progress bar, "Gerando resumo com IA..." | N/A |
| Concluído | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus=done` | "Resumo pronto", PDF+raw buttons shown (disabled; 7.2 wires taps) | N/A |
| Narrativa falhou/pulada | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus in {failed,skipped}` | Only raw button; copy scoped to narrative | N/A |
| Erro | `status=error`, other `errorCode` | Generic error copy, no download | Non-retryable, terminal |
| Período vazio | `errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | "Nenhum registro nesse período." + adjust-period suggestion | Maps to `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` |

</frozen-after-approval>

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no export entry point; the backend already exposes job creation (`POST /export/summary`) and polling (`GET /export/:jobId/status`), but `lib/features/export/` is three empty scaffold folders.

**Approach:** Build the `export` feature slice end to end: a download icon opens a period picker, confirming creates the job, and a bottom sheet polls status, swapping content in place across Pendente/Processando/Concluído/Erro/Período vazio, reusing existing sheet, button, and `Failure` infrastructure.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `export-summary-create`/`export-status-get` by `x-cerne-function` name, `jobId` as trailing path segment — never the literal REST paths.
- Poll only, never stream. Reuse the existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` for "Período vazio" — never add a new `Failure` subtype (AD-3).
- Model progress as its own sealed domain entity (mirror `BookmarkState`) — never force `status`+`narrativeStatus` into `Resource<T>` (AD-12).
- Sheet content replaces in place per stage change; sheet never closes/reopens mid-job; every state keeps "Fechar" (UX-DR15).
- Add `export-summary-create` to `RetryInterceptor.neverRetriedFunctions` (non-idempotent POST, no idempotency key — a transparent retry risks a duplicate job).

**Ask First:** None — docs/input is silent on poll cadence and the period-picker widget; both decided in Design Notes per AGENTS.md policy.

**Never:**
- Wire the real download (`GET /export/:jobId/download`) or make "Baixar PDF"/"Baixar dados brutos" tap-functional — Story 7.2.
- Give `data_ready` its own visual/download-enabled treatment — Story 7.2; render identically to "Processando" here.
- Add empty-period UX polish beyond `export-screen-states.md`'s table — Story 7.3.
- Persist jobs locally (no Hive box) — ephemeral, polled live (AD-15).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|------------------|-----------------|
| Create job | Confirm period | `jobId` stored, sheet opens Pendente | Create fails → inline error, sheet never opens |
| Pendente | `status=pending` | Spinner, "Preparando exportação..." | N/A |
| Processando | `status=processing\|data_ready` | Progress bar, "Gerando resumo com IA..." | N/A |
| Concluído | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus=done` | "Resumo pronto", PDF+raw buttons shown (disabled; 7.2 wires taps) | N/A |
| Narrativa falhou/pulada | `status=done`, `narrativeStatus in {failed,skipped}` | Only raw button; copy scoped to narrative | N/A |
| Erro | `status=error`, other `errorCode` | Generic error copy, no download | Non-retryable, terminal |
| Período vazio | `errorCode=EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | "Nenhum registro nesse período." + adjust-period suggestion | Maps to `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod` |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/export/{data,domain,presentation}/` -- empty scaffold; target for all files below
- `lib/core/network/{api_client,url_builder,retry_interceptor}.dart` -- call via `get/post(function, {pathParams})`; `neverRetriedFunctions:36-40` add `'export-summary-create'`
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart:30-31,67-83` -- `exportEmptyPeriod` already defined/wired; reuse only
- `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/bookmark_state.dart` -- sealed-base `const factory` pattern to mirror
- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart:44-46` -- `registerFactory<TextEntryCubit>` one-shot-cubit precedent
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart:93-97` -- add `registerExportFeature()` after chat
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet.dart:70-114,160-169` -- sheet choreography + shell to mirror (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`/`colorScrimHeavy`/`durationSheetUp`)
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:202` + `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` -- header call site/widget; add optional `trailing` param (default null)
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- `primary`/`secondaryOutline`/`textGhost` for PDF/raw/"Fechar"
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1417-1550` + `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md` -- schemas + authoritative status×narrativeStatus×downloadAvailable table
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:95-104` -- exact PT-BR copy per state

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`, `back_arrow_header.dart` (`trailing` param) -- visual plumbing
- [ ] `lib/features/export/domain/{entities/export_job_state.dart,repositories/export_repository.dart}` -- sealed `preparing`/`generating`/`done(outcome)`/`error(Failure)`/`emptyPeriod`; `createJob(...) -> Either<Failure,String>`, `getStatus(jobId) -> Either<Failure,ExportJobState>`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/{models/export_job_status_dto.dart(+.g.dart),datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart,repositories/export_repository_impl.dart}` -- DTO + calls to the two functions + thin repository pass-through (no cache); DTO→state mapping per the status table
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<ExportJobState>`; `start()` creates job then `Timer.periodic` (2s) polls to a terminal state; cancels in `close()`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart` -- static `.show(context, {cubit})` mirroring filter-sheet choreography; `BlocBuilder` swaps body per state
- [ ] `lib/features/export/export_injection.dart` + `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- `registerExportFeature()` (singleton data source + repository, `registerFactory<ExportJobCubit>`), wired in
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- download icon in header trailing slot; `onTap` → `showDateRangePicker` → `start()` → `ExportStatusSheet.show()`
- [ ] `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart` -- add `'export-summary-create'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`
- [ ] Unit tests: `ExportJobCubit` transitions (I/O matrix rows), `ExportRemoteDataSource` DTO→state mapping incl. empty period

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I tap the download icon and select a period, when I confirm, then the job is created and the export sheet opens (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`).
- Given the job is in progress, when polled, then the sheet reflects the five named states, `status`/`narrativeStatus` independent.
- Given a stage changes, when the sheet updates, then content replaces in place — never closes/reopens mid-job.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- Poll: fixed 2s `Timer.periodic`, no client timeout (docs/input silent; server job always reaches a terminal state).
- Period picker: Flutter's built-in `showDateRangePicker` (docs/input silent; free-form dates, unlike the 3 fixed `DateRangePreset` filter presets).
- `data_ready` folds into `generating`'s visual here (no case of its own) — same copy/no-download, since lighting it up is 7.2's job.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates the DTO's `.g.dart`, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- all pass, incl. new cubit/data-source tests

- [ ] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`, `back_arrow_header.dart` (`trailing` param) -- visual plumbing
- [ ] `lib/features/export/domain/{entities/export_job_state.dart,repositories/export_repository.dart}` -- sealed `preparing`/`generating`/`done(outcome)`/`error(Failure)`/`emptyPeriod`; `createJob(...) -> Either<Failure,String>`, `getStatus(jobId) -> Either<Failure,ExportJobState>`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/data/{models/export_job_status_dto.dart(+.g.dart),datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart,repositories/export_repository_impl.dart}` -- DTO + calls to the two functions + thin repository pass-through (no cache); DTO→state mapping per the status table
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<ExportJobState>`; `start()` creates job then `Timer.periodic` (2s) polls to a terminal state; cancels in `close()`
- [ ] `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart` -- static `.show(context, {cubit})` mirroring filter-sheet choreography; `BlocBuilder` swaps body per state
- [ ] `lib/features/export/export_injection.dart` + `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- `registerExportFeature()` (singleton data source + repository, `registerFactory<ExportJobCubit>`), wired in
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- download icon in header trailing slot; `onTap` → `showDateRangePicker` → `start()` → `ExportStatusSheet.show()`
- [ ] `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart` -- add `'export-summary-create'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`
- [ ] Unit tests: `ExportJobCubit` transitions (I/O matrix rows), `ExportRemoteDataSource` DTO→state mapping incl. empty period

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I tap the download icon and select a period, when I confirm, then the job is created and the export sheet opens (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`).
- Given the job is in progress, when polled, then the sheet reflects the five named states, `status`/`narrativeStatus` independent.
- Given a stage changes, when the sheet updates, then content replaces in place — never closes/reopens mid-job.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- Poll: fixed 2s `Timer.periodic`, no client timeout (docs/input silent; server job always reaches a terminal state).
- Period picker: Flutter's built-in `showDateRangePicker` (docs/input silent; free-form dates, unlike the 3 fixed `DateRangePreset` filter presets).
- `data_ready` folds into `generating`'s visual here (no case of its own) — same copy/no-download, since lighting it up is 7.2's job.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates the DTO's `.g.dart`, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- all pass, incl. new cubit/data-source tests

Shared sub-step for updating `sprint-status.yaml` during build. Called from any route (plan-code-review, one-shot, future routes) with a `target_status` parameter.

## Preconditions

Skip this entire file (return to caller) if ANY of:
- `story_key` is unset
- `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` does not exist on disk

## Instructions

1. Load the FULL `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` file.
2. Find the `development_status` entry matching `{story_key}`. If not found, warn the user once (`"{story_key} not found in sprint-status; skipping sprint sync"`) and return to caller.
3. **Idempotency check.** If `development_status[{story_key}]` is already at `target_status` or a later state (`review` is later than `in-progress`; `done` is later than both), return to caller — no write needed. Never regress a story's status.
4. Set `development_status[{story_key}]` to `{target_status}`.
5. **Epic lift (only when `target_status` = `in-progress`).** Derive the parent epic key as `epic-{N}` from the leading numeric segment of `{story_key}` (e.g., `3-2-digest-delivery` → `epic-3`). If that entry exists and is `backlog`, set it to `in-progress`. Leave it alone otherwise. Skip this sub-step entirely when `target_status` is not `in-progress`.
6. Refresh `last_updated` to the current date.
7. Save the file, preserving ALL comments and structure including STATUS DEFINITIONS and WORKFLOW NOTES.

- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- `primary`/`secondaryOutline`/`textGhost` for PDF/raw/"Fechar"
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1417-1550` + `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md` -- schemas + authoritative status×narrativeStatus×downloadAvailable table
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:95-104` -- exact PT-BR copy per state

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart`, `back_arrow_header.dart` (`trailing` param) -- visual plumbing
- [x] `lib/features/export/domain/{entities/export_job_state.dart,repositories/export_repository.dart}` -- sealed `preparing`/`generating`/`done(outcome)`/`error(Failure)`/`emptyPeriod`; `createJob(...) -> Either<Failure,String>`, `getStatus(jobId) -> Either<Failure,ExportJobState>`
- [x] `lib/features/export/data/{models/export_job_status_dto.dart(+.g.dart),datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart,repositories/export_repository_impl.dart}` -- DTO + calls to the two functions + thin repository pass-through (no cache); DTO→state mapping per the status table
- [x] `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<ExportJobState>`; `start()` creates job then `Timer.periodic` (2s) polls to a terminal state; cancels in `close()`
- [x] `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart` -- static `.show(context, {cubit})` mirroring filter-sheet choreography; `BlocBuilder` swaps body per state
- [x] `lib/features/export/export_injection.dart` + `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- `registerExportFeature()` (singleton data source + repository, `registerFactory<ExportJobCubit>`), wired in
- [x] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- download icon in header trailing slot; `onTap` → `showDateRangePicker` → `start()` → `ExportStatusSheet.show()`
- [x] `lib/core/network/retry_interceptor.dart` -- add `'export-summary-create'` to `neverRetriedFunctions`
- [x] Unit tests: `ExportJobCubit` transitions (I/O matrix rows), `ExportRemoteDataSource` DTO→state mapping incl. empty period

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given I tap the download icon and select a period, when I confirm, then the job is created and the export sheet opens (`radiusLg`/`elevation2`).
- Given the job is in progress, when polled, then the sheet reflects the five named states, `status`/`narrativeStatus` independent.
- Given a stage changes, when the sheet updates, then content replaces in place — never closes/reopens mid-job.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

- Poll: fixed 2s `Timer.periodic`, no client timeout (docs/input silent; server job always reaches a terminal state).
- Period picker: Flutter's built-in `showDateRangePicker` (docs/input silent; free-form dates, unlike the 3 fixed `DateRangePreset` filter presets).
- `data_ready` folds into `generating`'s visual here (no case of its own) — same copy/no-download, since lighting it up is 7.2's job.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates the DTO's `.g.dart`, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- all pass, incl. new cubit/data-source tests

1	import '../../../../core/failure/failure.dart';
2	
3	/// spec-7-1 — the export job's own progress, modeled as its own sealed
4	/// domain entity (AD-12: never force `status`+`narrativeStatus` into
5	/// `Resource<T>`), mirroring `BookmarkState`'s own shape: sealed, with
6	/// `const factory` constructors declared on the base class so call sites
7	/// read as `ExportJobState.preparing()` rather than naming each subclass
8	/// directly. Exactly the 5 states `docs/input/backend/export-screen-
9	/// states.md`'s own status×narrativeStatus×downloadAvailable table
10	/// collapses into (`data_ready` folds into [ExportJobState.generating],
11	/// Design Notes — no case of its own here).
12	///
13	/// Never persisted (AD-15: ephemeral, polled live) — lives only on
14	/// `ExportJobCubit.state`.
15	sealed class ExportJobState {
16	  const ExportJobState();
17	
18	  /// `status: 'pending'` — spinner, "Preparando exportação...". Also this
19	  /// cubit's own initial state, since `export-summary-create`'s 202
20	  /// response always answers `status: 'pending'` (`openapi.yaml`), so no
21	  /// separate "creating..." state is needed before that call resolves.
22	  const factory ExportJobState.preparing() = ExportJobPreparing;
23	
24	  /// `status in {processing, data_ready}` — progress bar, "Gerando resumo
25	  /// com IA...". `data_ready` renders identically to `processing` here
26	  /// (Design Notes/Never: lighting up its own download-enabled treatment
27	  /// is Story 7.2's job).
28	  const factory ExportJobState.generating() = ExportJobGenerating;
29	
30	  /// `status: 'done'` — [outcome] distinguishes "Concluído" (narrative
31	  /// succeeded, both download buttons shown) from "Narrativa falhou/
32	  /// pulada" (only the raw-data button, copy scoped to the narrative
33	  /// failure) without needing two separate sealed variants for what is,
34	  /// to the job itself, one and the same terminal success.
35	  const factory ExportJobState.done(ExportOutcome outcome) = ExportJobDone;
36	
37	  /// `status: 'error'`, any `errorCode` other than `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` —
38	  /// generic error copy, no download, non-retryable/terminal. [failure]
39	  /// is always built via the one shared `Failure.fromCode` (AD-3) — never
40	  /// a second, ad hoc mapping of the raw `errorCode` string.
41	  const factory ExportJobState.error(Failure failure) = ExportJobError;
42	
43	  /// `status: 'error'`, `errorCode: 'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD'` — "Nenhum
44	  /// registro nesse período." + an adjust-period suggestion, no download.
45	  /// AD-3 ("reuse the existing `Failure.exportEmptyPeriod`... never add a
46	  /// new `Failure` subtype") is honored one layer down, in
47	  /// `ExportJobStatusDto.toState()`: that mapping step always goes
48	  /// through `Failure.fromCode` first and only reaches this case by
49	  /// checking the *subtype* it returns — this variant itself carries no
50	  /// `Failure` of its own, since by the time the job-level state is
51	  /// "empty period" there is nothing further for the UI to do with one
52	  /// (no retry, no message beyond the copy above).
53	  const factory ExportJobState.emptyPeriod() = ExportJobEmptyPeriod;
54	}
55	
56	/// The default state — outline spinner, tappable only via "Fechar".
57	class ExportJobPreparing extends ExportJobState {
58	  const ExportJobPreparing();
59	
60	  @override
61	  bool operator ==(Object other) => other is ExportJobPreparing;
62	
63	  @override
64	  int get hashCode => (ExportJobPreparing).hashCode;
65	
66	  @override
67	  String toString() => 'ExportJobPreparing()';
68	}
69	
70	class ExportJobGenerating extends ExportJobState {
71	  const ExportJobGenerating();
72	
73	  @override
74	  bool operator ==(Object other) => other is ExportJobGenerating;
75	
76	  @override
77	  int get hashCode => (ExportJobGenerating).hashCode;
78	
79	  @override
80	  String toString() => 'ExportJobGenerating()';
81	}
82	
83	/// [ExportJobDone]'s own two flavors — never a boolean, so a third future
84	/// outcome (unlikely, but the taxonomy's own `narrativeStatus` enum has
85	/// exactly `done`/`failed`/`skipped`, the latter two collapsing here into
86	/// one) never silently reads as the wrong one of only two choices.
87	enum ExportOutcome {
88	  /// `narrativeStatus: 'done'` — "Resumo pronto", PDF + raw buttons
89	  /// (disabled this story; Story 7.2 wires the taps).
90	  narrativeReady,
91	
92	  /// `narrativeStatus in {failed, skipped}` — only the raw-data button
93	  /// (disabled this story), copy scoped to the narrative failure, not a
94	  /// job-wide error.
95	  narrativeUnavailable,
96	}
97	
98	class ExportJobDone extends ExportJobState {
99	  const ExportJobDone(this.outcome);
100	
101	  final ExportOutcome outcome;
102	
103	  @override
104	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
105	      identical(this, other) || (other is ExportJobDone && other.outcome == outcome);
106	
107	  @override
108	  int get hashCode => outcome.hashCode;
109	
110	  @override
111	  String toString() => 'ExportJobDone(outcome: $outcome)';
112	}
113	
114	/// The job itself failed — red warning, terminal (I/O matrix: "Non-
115	/// retryable, terminal"). [failure] is kept for parity with
116	/// `BookmarkError`'s own shape, even though the sheet only ever needs
117	/// generic error copy, never [failure].message, for this variant (the
118	/// taxonomy's own 13 codes carry no export-specific text).
119	class ExportJobError extends ExportJobState {
120	  const ExportJobError(this.failure);
121	
122	  final Failure failure;
123	
124	  @override
125	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
126	      identical(this, other) || (other is ExportJobError && other.failure == failure);
127	
128	  @override
129	  int get hashCode => failure.hashCode;
130	
131	  @override
132	  String toString() => 'ExportJobError(failure: $failure)';
133	}
134	
135	/// "Período vazio" — see [ExportJobState.emptyPeriod]'s own doc for why
136	/// this variant carries no [Failure] of its own.
137	class ExportJobEmptyPeriod extends ExportJobState {
138	  const ExportJobEmptyPeriod();
139	
140	  @override
141	  bool operator ==(Object other) => other is ExportJobEmptyPeriod;
142	
143	  @override
144	  int get hashCode => (ExportJobEmptyPeriod).hashCode;
145	
146	  @override
147	  String toString() => 'ExportJobEmptyPeriod()';
148	}

(By contrast, the other four states' copy — "Preparando exportação...", "Gerando resumo com IA...", "Resumo pronto", "Nenhum registro nesse período." / "Ajuste o filtro de período e tente de novo." — matches the prototype verbatim, confirmed by grepping the raw HTML.)   - Equality/`hashCode` style is inconsistent across the new sealed variants in `export_job_state.dart`: `ExportJobDone`/`ExportJobError` use `identical(this, other) || (other is X && ...)`, while `ExportJobPreparing`/`ExportJobGenerating`/`ExportJobEmptyPeriod` use a bare `other is X` with no `identical` fast path — harmless here since those are zero-field classes, but an avoidable inconsistency within one new file that a single shared pattern would have avoided.

  - `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` (`_onExportTap`) calls `showDateRangePicker`, but the app has no `flutter_localizations` dependency and no `localizationsDelegates`/`supportedLocales` configured anywhere (checked `pubspec.yaml` and the sole `MaterialApp.router` in `lib/main.dart`).   - `lib/features/export/data/datasources/export_remote_data_source.dart`'s `createJob` sends `periodStart.toUtc().toIso8601String()` / `periodEnd.toUtc()...` where both dates come straight from `showDateRangePicker`, which returns local-midnight `DateTime`s. For any user whose local offset is ahead of UTC, `toUtc()` rolls local midnight back to the previous UTC calendar day, silently shifting the requested export window by a day; even in offset-behind-UTC zones, sending the end date as local midnight (rather than end-of-day) risks excluding entries created later on the selected end day, depending on how the backend interprets the bound.   - The backend's `export.summary.create` operation summary in `openapi.yaml` is literally "Request export — synchronous count, enqueues the job," which suggests `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` may be returned synchronously from `POST /export/summary` itself for an empty period, not only via the `GET /export/{jobId}/status` poll the implementation's "Período vazio" handling is built around. `_onExportTap`'s create-failure branch (`!started`) only ever shows the raw `Failure.message` in a generic `SnackBar` — it never routes through the dedicated "Nenhum registro nesse período." + adjust-period copy that `ExportJobState.emptyPeriod()` exists for.   - `lib/features/export/presentation/cubit/export_job_cubit.dart`: `_startPolling()` drives `_poll()` off a `Timer.periodic(_pollInterval, ...)` with no guard against overlapping ticks.   - Same file: a `Left` from `getStatus` is unconditionally swallowed every tick with no distinction between a transient blip and a persistent failure (`AUTH_EXPIRED`, a 404 if the job record is gone, sustained `NETWORK_OFFLINE`, etc.).   - `lib/features/export/data/models/export_job_status_dto.dart`'s `toState()` treats any `status: 'done'` + `narrativeStatus != 'done'` as `ExportOutcome.narrativeUnavailable` ("a narrativa falhou" copy). The contract's `narrativeStatus` enum (`openapi.yaml`) also includes `pending`/`processing` — i.e. the raw export can be `done` while the narrative is simply still running. That combination isn't in `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md`'s table either, but the code has no explicit case for it and silently folds it into "narrative failed," which would show the wrong message if that combination is ever actually reachable.
  
  - `ExportJobState.error` (the job-level failure variant — icon + "Não foi possível gerar a exportação.", no button) has no counterpart in `docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html`. (By contrast, the other four states' copy — "Preparando exportação...", "Gerando resumo com IA...", "Resumo pronto", "Nenhum registro nesse período." / "Ajuste o filtro de período e tente de novo." — matches the prototype verbatim, confirmed by grepping the raw HTML.) The spec's Code Map cites `prototype-extract.md:95-104` as the source of "exact PT-BR copy per state" for all states, but this one state's copy/visual was invented rather than extracted, and is worth a second look against the backend's own distinct "Export error" row in `export-screen-states.md` to confirm the UI treatment is intentional.
  
  - No test exercises the new presentation layer at all: `test/features/export/` only covers `ExportRemoteDataSource` and `ExportJobCubit`. `lib/features/export/presentation/widgets/export_status_sheet.dart`, the new `_ExportIconButton`/`_onExportTap` flow in `meus_registros_screen.dart`, and `BackArrowHeader`'s new `trailing` slot have zero coverage. I confirmed `test/core/widgets/back_arrow_header_test.dart` and `test/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart` were not touched by this diff and contain no mention of "trailing"/"export"/"download" — the acceptance criteria about the sheet opening with `radiusLg`/`elevation2` and the tap→picker→create→sheet choreography are asserted only in the spec doc, not in any test.
  
  - `openapi.yaml` marks both `periodStart`/`periodEnd` as `nullable`, implying the backend supports an all-time export, but `_onExportTap` always awaits a `DateTimeRange` and bails out on cancel, and `ExportRepository.createJob`/`ExportRemoteDataSource.createJob` don't even accept nullable dates — that backend-supported capability is fully closed off with no note that it's deliberately out of scope (vs. e.g. download wiring, which is explicitly deferred to Story 7.2 in the spec's "Never" list).
  
  - `ExportJobStatusDto.toJson()` / generated `_$ExportJobStatusDtoToJson` is dead code: the DTO is only ever produced by `fromJson` from a `getStatus` response and never serialized back out anywhere in the feature.
  
  - Equality/`hashCode` style is inconsistent across the new sealed variants in `export_job_state.dart`: `ExportJobDone`/`ExportJobError` use `identical(this, other) || (other is X && ...)`, while `ExportJobPreparing`/`ExportJobGenerating`/`ExportJobEmptyPeriod` use a bare `other is X` with no `identical` fast path — harmless here since those are zero-field classes, but an avoidable inconsistency within one new file that a single shared pattern would have avoided.
  
  Verified as non-issues while investigating (noted in case they come up again): `fvm flutter analyze` is clean, the full new test suite passes, `RetryInterceptor`'s existing parametrized test already iterates `neverRetriedFunctions` so `export-summary-create` is covered without a dedicated test, `Failure.fromCode`/`exportEmptyPeriod` wiring matches AD-3 as claimed, the `export-summary-create`/`export-status-get` function names and the DTO's required fields match `openapi.yaml` exactly, and the `data_ready`-folds-into-`generating` behavior is explicitly specced (not a gap).
</agent-message>
